Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class OfferText

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.OfferText
public final class OfferText extends Object
How a price offer, borrow request or claim reads on every screen that shows one: the chat history (UC6), My Deals (UC7), the seller's offers and the admin's deal records. One place, so a deal is worded the same in all three portals.

  • Method Details

    • actionText

      public static String actionText(ListingType type)
      What the buyer's action on a listing is called, by listing type (Task 1.4): "Make Offer" for a sale, "Request Borrow" for a lend listing, "Claim Item" for a giveaway. The same words are on the detail screen's button and on the Make Offer option in a chat (UC5 step 1).

    • submitted

      public static String submitted(Offer offer, String listingTitle)
      The confirmation after Make Offer (UC5 step 9): "Your price offer for 'Desk Lamp' was submitted: HK$ 160. The seller has been notified." For a claim, which has no terms: "Your claim for 'Desk Lamp' was submitted. The seller has been notified."

    • kind

      public static String kind(Offer offer)
      "Price offer", "Borrow request" or "Claim".

    • summary

      public static String summary(Offer offer)
      What the buyer proposed: "Price offer: HK$ 160", "Borrow request: 10 Nov 2026 09:00 – 17 Nov 2026 09:00", or "Claim" (a claim has no terms).

    • terms

      public static String terms(Offer offer)
      What the buyer proposed, without the kind of offer: "HK$ 160" or "10 Nov 2026 09:00 – 17 Nov 2026 09:00". Empty for a claim, which has no terms.

    • counter

      public static Optional<String> counter(Offer offer)
      The seller's counter, if there is one: "Seller's counter: HK$ 170" or "Seller's counter: 11 Nov 2026 09:00 – 18 Nov 2026 09:00". Empty for an offer that was not countered; a claim cannot be countered.

    • counterTerms

      public static Optional<String> counterTerms(Offer offer)
      The terms of the seller's counter, without a label: "HK$ 170" or a period; empty if there is none.

    • status

      public static String status(Offer offer)
      "Pending", "Accepted", "Declined" or "Countered". Once the deal is completed: "Completed" for a purchase or claim, and for a borrowed item "Returned" if the buyer returned it or "Auto-returned" if it was returned when its period ended (UC12 step 4; UC11).

    • badgeStyle

      public static String badgeStyle(Offer offer)
      The status badge's style class in styles.css: orange while waiting, green, red, or blue.
